verdict_vs_current.quote: As offered, this is a pay cut for a move to the same level.

recommendation.quote: Negotiate, and be ready to walk away if Google can't at least match what you make now.

equity_grounding.quote: My current total comp is about $526K a year, I'd be walking away from about $200K in stock vesting over the next 12 months plus my annual bonus

caveat_tenure_current_employer.quote: Meta's $250K a year in stock likely already includes stacked refreshes, which continue if you stay.

refresh_valued_at.quote: Refreshes are a bonus if they come, so don't count on them when deciding.

level_claim.quote: Meta IC6 and Google L6 are equivalent, so there's no promotion here to make up for less money.

walkaway_tied_to.quote: I'd walk away if Google won't get your guaranteed year 1 to at least ~$550K, with years 2–4 (not counting refreshes) not falling well below $526K.

unsupported_claims.claim: Stock and sign-on bonuses usually have more room to negotiate than base salary.
unsupported_claims.quote: Stock and sign-on bonuses usually have more room than base.

ask_focus.quote: Ask for about $255K base, a $1.2M stock grant and a $75K sign-on.

rsu_annualized.quote: If yours vests evenly, you lose about $68K in year 1. If it's front-loaded, year 1 is roughly a wash

year1_vs_recurring.quote: guaranteed year 1 to at least ~$550K, with years 2–4 (not counting refreshes) not falling well below $526K.

forfeiture_as_loss.quote: and a $75K sign-on to cover what I'd forfeit.
